findings.summary: manage.rs is a listed deliverable but probably needs no edit.
findings.evidence: I grepped for LandingCommit and commit.job. manage.rs:533 only passes `history.commits` through and never builds a LandingCommit, so the plan will most likely leave manage.rs unedited even though it is a listed deliverable. Fix: State plainly that manage.rs is expected to stay unchanged because it only passes the commits through, so the verifier does not count a missing manage.rs diff against the job.

findings.summary: Filtering job_ids in intent() could later produce an intent that fails validation.
findings.evidence: intent() fills job_ids from commit.job (gh.rs:1476-1481), and LandingIntent::validate rejects an empty job_ids (history.rs:105). Today every commit is job_landing, so nothing changes. In part 2, though, a PR made only of non-job commits would produce an intent that fails validation. Fix: Use filter_map over Some(job) as planned, and add a code comment or CHANGELOG note that handling non-job-only PRs is part 2's job. Do not change LandingIntent here.

findings.summary: The deny_unknown_fields check for criterion 1 relies on reading the diff.
findings.evidence: Checking that deny_unknown_fields was kept 'by diff inspection' is a presence check. The criterion 3 test that rejects an unknown field already shows it as behavior. Fix: Point the criterion 1 deny_unknown_fields check at the unknown-field rejection test instead of the diff.

summary: I read history.rs, the gh.rs builder and intent(), display.rs, and grepped for every use of LandingCommit and commit.job. The plan matches the request and the accepted reading. LandingCommit (history.rs:133) is the right place to add the kind. Landing::validate (history.rs:168) already loops over the commits, so the per-kind checks fit there. In gh.rs, commits() at line 1419 is the only production builder. intent() at lines 1476-1481 is the only place outside history.rs that reads commit.job, and it would break once job is an Option; the plan covers it. The two test constructors (history.rs:411, gh.rs:3788) are covered too. display.rs:1280 iterates a different `commits` list, so it needs no change. HistoryError is not matched exhaustively outside history.rs, so adding variants is safe. Each demonstration would fail without its behavior: required closed-enum parsing, per-kind Err assertions, and the equality check in the gh landing test. The design keeps the flat JSON shape and leaves pr_commits alone. Only minor points remain.
